admin.ag_wizard_welcome_lede: Publish a structured guide so AI systems can discover who you are, what you offer, and what you stand behind.
admin.ag_wizard_why_body: After publish, your guide is available at a public URL. Chatbots and agents can read it instead of guessing from scattered pages.

admin.ai_presence_what_body: Agent Guide is your published map for AI systems and agents. You declare where the truth lives, write a concise summary, link proof, and publish a machine-readable guide on your site.
admin.ai_presence_what_note: You edit a draft, then explicitly Publish. Public endpoints only serve the published version.

admin.ai_presence_pub_views_help: Exposes summary, products, and claims API endpoints that return JSON snapshots of your published context.

admin.ai_presence_api_views_help: Read-only JSON endpoints available after publishing. Use view=summary, view=products, or view=claims.
admin.ai_presence_tab_context_lede: Profile identity and positioning. Summaries here should reflect your declared sources of truth.

admin.ai_presence_tab_claims_lede: Verifiable statements. Attach evidence before marking a claim as supported.
admin.ai_presence_tab_publish_lede: Enable public endpoints, preview how AI might answer questions, then publish when ready.

admin.ai_presence_what_benefit_2: Chatbots, site agents, and MCP-connected tools can read one canonical JSON guide instead of scraping your whole site.
admin.ai_presence_what_benefit_3: You keep CMS pages, PDFs, and external listings as sources of truth; Agent Guide summarizes and links back to them.
admin.ai_presence_what_benefit_4: Claims and evidence let you publish what you can prove — with URLs agents can verify.
